finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Panel titles on the provisioned dashboard "Service health" (URL `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health`), in order: **Request rate**, **Error count**, **Latency by endpoint** (3 panels, no collapsed rows).

**2. DONE** — New dashboard **"fwgr36-n1 Bench Dashboard"** created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled **"fwgr36-n1 Availability"** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (default Random Walk scenario). Verified by reopening the panel editor: data source picker reads "TestData" (logo alt "TestData logo", TestData-specific query options), visualization picker reads "Stat".

**3. DONE** — The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled **"fwgr36-n1 Notes"** with content **"Bench notes for run fwgr36-n1"** (includes the runid). Saved — confirmed still rendered after a fresh page reload.

**4. DONE** — Dashboard tag is **"bench"** (Settings > General shows exactly one tag chip, "bench") and the time range is **Last 6 hours**, persisted in the saved dashboard: a fresh load with no URL params opens at "Last 6 hours", and Grafana rewrites the URL to `?from=now-6h&to=now`. (Note: the "Update default time range" checkbox only appears when the picker differs from the stored default; it was absent because the stored default already was 6 hours, which itself proves persistence.)

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval is **1m**, persisted: saved via the save drawer's "Update default refresh value" checkbox ("Dashboard saved" alert appeared), and after a fresh reload the top-bar refresh selector reads "1m" (aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected").

**6. DONE** — URL read from the browser address bar after loading the dashboard with no query params (Grafana rewrote it to canonical form): **`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffy9snbh00i68a/fwgr36-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`** — UID **ffy9snbh00i68a**.
